selectionGuide.description: Two stacked panels pair a rejecting gesture with an approving gesture to express a simple preference.
bestFor: rejecting one option in favor of a clearly preferred alternative
contrasting an old habit with a better replacement
showing inconsistent priorities through a compact two-choice comparison
avoidWhen: both options are equally undesirable or difficult
the joke depends on a chronological story rather than a preference
more than two choices need separate labels

mechanics.visual: The first panel visibly refuses its option, while the second panel approves the alternative, making the hierarchy immediate.
mechanics.text: Put the rejected option in no and the preferred option in yes; concise, grammatically parallel phrases make the contrast strongest.
